description: This file defines a Java interface named 'Lifecycle' that declares methods for managing the lifecycle of a component, including starting and stopping the component using asynchronous 'Future<Void>' return types.

classes.name: Lifecycle
classes.description: An interface to manage the life cycle of a component with methods to start and stop it asynchronously.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the startup process of the component, returning a Future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Initiates the shutdown process of the component, returning a Future indicating success or failure.
